elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Section 13.4 now limits “each party's total liability” to the same cap.

elements.element: The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The cap uses fees paid or payable during the 12 months prior to the event, but provides no USD 1,000,000 floor or greater-of formulation.

elements.element: The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Section 13.2 states that neither Customer nor M&I is liable for indirect, incidental, punitive, special, or consequential damages.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: The first-sentence liability cap expressly does not apply to a party's breach of its confidentiality obligations under Section 17.

elements.element: Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: No carve-out addresses data protection or security obligations.
The first-sentence liability cap expressly does not apply to a party's indemnification obligations under Section 14.2.
Gross negligence is expressly excluded from the first-sentence liability cap.
Willful misconduct is expressly excluded from the first-sentence liability cap; the spelling variation does not alter its effect.
Fraud is not included among the exceptions to the liability cap.

elements.element: Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no uncapped carve-out for infringement of the other party's intellectual property.

elements.element: Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
elements.evidence: The collection proviso only excepts amounts due from the one-year action limitation; it does not exclude Customer payment obligations from the monetary cap.

elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Section 13.4 applies the total-liability cap to “each party.”

elements.element: The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
elements.evidence: The cap equals fees paid or payable during the twelve months prior to the event.
A party's indemnification obligations under Section 14.2 are expressly excluded from the cap.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: A party's breach of its confidentiality obligations under Section 17 is expressly excluded from the cap.
Gross negligence is expressly excluded from the cap.
Willful misconduct is expressly excluded from the cap.
